summary: Feature add-solid-color-rendering-tests passed scrutiny. Implementation adds comprehensive unit test coverage for VAL-ATLAS-002 (solid color rendering via white pixel sampling). All 4 test requirements from feature description are verified: (1) Vertex::position_only() UV coordinates set to (0,0), (2) add_rect uses TextureId::NONE, (3) vertex colors correctly applied with RGBA conversion, (4) color preservation through conversion. Worker followed TDD approach, maintained dependency boundaries, and adhered to project coding conventions. No blocking or non-blocking issues identified.
